applyTo: '**/*.md'

# Markdown Authoring and Quality Instructions

Apply these instructions whenever creating or substantially editing Markdown.

## Structure and Writing

- Put content where its audience belongs: developer, internal, product, pitch,
  or OpenSpec documentation.
- Use Diataxis: tutorials teach, how-to guides enable tasks, reference records
  facts, and explanation explores concepts or decisions.
- Keep folders, navigation, sections, and sibling document groups to five
  through seven items where practical. Group or split larger collections.
- Start with purpose and reader outcome. Use short paragraphs, clear headings,
  direct language, focused lists, and links to related detail.
- Preserve context, prerequisites, decisions, constraints, and edge cases.
  Remove filler, repetition, generic framing, and unsupported claims.

## AI Quality Gate

Before finalizing Markdown you create or substantially revise, rate it privately.
Use a 1 to 100 scale and these five equally weighted dimensions:

| Dimension       | What to assess                                                 |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Human voice     | Specific and natural; not generic or recognizably AI-generated |
| Content quality | Accurate, concrete, consistent, and audience-appropriate       |
| Reading flow    | Logical, clear, scannable, and concise                         |
| Completeness    | Enough information to understand or act correctly              |
| Proportion      | Neither too much nor too little detail for the purpose         |

Calculate the overall score as the arithmetic mean of the five dimension scores.
Revise Markdown on your own until every dimension scores at least 85 and the
overall score is at least 90. Reassess after each revision. Do not include the
private scores or this evaluation in finished Markdown unless the user asks.
